create.name: Kannon Do Zen Meditation Center
create.bio:
Kannon Do is a Soto Zen temple in Mountain View, California, serving Silicon Valley in the line of Shunryu Suzuki. Its roots lie in Haiku Zendo, a converted garage in Los Altos where Suzuki gave the evening talks later gathered into Zen Mind, Beginner's Mind. Les Kaye, an IBM engineer whom Suzuki ordained in 1971, looked after that zendo, moved the community to Mountain View in 1978 under its present name, and served as abbot for four decades; he died in September 2026. The current temple on Rock Street opened in 2006, and Zoketsu Norman Fischer, a former abbot of San Francisco Zen Center, is now its guiding teacher.

The centre is non-residential and run by volunteers, with no membership needed to take part. Zazen is held early each weekday morning, at noon and in the evening, and on Saturdays a longer morning programme combines sitting, walking meditation, a short service, a shared breakfast and temple cleaning. Wednesday evenings bring meditation and a Dharma talk, with most sessions also open on Zoom. Practice periods, one-day and half-day sittings and a long-running podcast of talks round out its programme.

courses.title: Half-Day Meditation Retreat led by Misha Shungen Merrill
courses.description: A morning of sitting, walking and mindful eating in the zendo, led by affiliate teacher Misha Shungen Merrill, followed by lunch and an afternoon of work practice preparing the temple and grounds. Those wishing to attend are asked to get in touch with the organiser beforehand.

courses.title: Saturday Mornings
courses.description: The weekly Saturday programme: two early periods of zazen with walking meditation between, a brief chanting service, a vegetarian potluck breakfast, temple cleaning and a final sitting. Newcomers can come at 9 am for an in-person introduction to sitting.

courses.title: Wednesday Nights
courses.description: A weekly evening of meditation followed by a Dharma talk and questions, held in the zendo and on Zoom. First-time sitters are invited to arrive twenty minutes early for instruction.

free_resources.title: Kannon Do Zen Meditation Center Podcasts
free_resources.description: More than three hundred recorded Dharma talks from the centre's weekly lectures, given by its teachers, priests and practice leaders, each downloadable as an MP3 or available through podcast apps.

free_resources.title: Introduction to Practice
free_resources.description: Illustrated guidance on zendo etiquette, sitting postures on a cushion or chair, the hand mudra, breathing and walking meditation, also offered as a printable tri-fold PDF.

free_resources.title: Meditation at Home
free_resources.description: Practical advice for keeping a daily sitting practice at home: choosing a quiet place, how long to sit, ways of keeping time, and the value of steady commitment and a regular hour.
